issue_context.title: systemd-network-generator not generating correct VLAN netdev files from command line
issue_context.body:
### systemd version the issue has been seen with

256.4-2

### Used distribution

Debian Testing

### Linux kernel version used

6.9.12-amd64

### CPU architectures issue was seen on

x86_64

### Component

systemd-network-generator

### Expected behaviour you didn't see

When using Dracut in combination with systemd-networkd module, I can set up a VLAN for ISCSI root via `vlan=enp4s0f0np0.92:enp4s0f0np0` kernel command line parameter.

### Unexpected behaviour you saw

The VLAN is not brought up because the .netdev file generated from the `vlan=` parameter lacks the VLAN ID field in the configuration, so the VLAN interface doesn't get created.

### Steps to reproduce the problem

See output below for repro with systemd-network-generator

### Additional program output to the terminal or log subsystem illustrating the issue

```sh
> /usr/lib/systemd/systemd-network-generator --root=/tmp/t vlan=enp4s0f0np0.92:enp4s0f0np0 ip=192.168.92.11:::255.255.255.0::enp4s0f0np0.92:off:9000

> cat /tmp/t/run/systemd/network/70-enp4s0f0np0.92.netdev 
# Automatically generated by systemd-network-generator

[NetDev]
Kind=vlan
Name=enp4s0f0np0.92

> cat /tmp/t/run/systemd/network/70-enp4s0f0np0.92.network 
# Automatically generated by systemd-network-generator

[Match]
Name=enp4s0f0np0.92

[Link]
MTUBytes=9000

[Network]
DHCP=no
LinkLocalAddressing=no
IPv6AcceptRA=no

[DHCP]

[Address]
Address=192.168.92.11/24
```
